source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 January 1928, p. 8 ("Municipal Elections")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Nomination report: 'Glen Ward - J. J. Black, unopposed.'

note: Annual election of the Newtownards Urban Council, January 1928. One seat was vacant in each of the five wards. Castle and Scrabo were both contested at nomination, but by polling day the only contest was in Scrabo Ward; W. M'Alpine was returned unopposed for Castle Ward. Returned unopposed.
